news.title: Happy 5th Anniversary to Gaddiel Nursery and Preparatory School!
news.imageAlt: Gaddiel pupils, staff and families gathered together outdoors
news.summary: 13 September 2021 – 13 September 2026. Today, with humility and pride, we give all glory and honour to Almighty God for five incredible years of grace, favour and faithfulness.
body: “Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.” – Proverbs 22:6

For five years, the Lord has helped us nurture minds, build godly character and shape the leaders of tomorrow. We are deeply grateful to God for our dedicated Director, teachers, staff, wonderful parents and amazing pupils, who make our school family so special.
As we celebrate this milestone, we pray for many more years of wisdom, growth, success and divine prosperity ahead, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

news.title: Admissions are open
news.imageAlt: A smiling pupil at his desk in a Gaddiel classroom
news.summary: Admissions are open for Nursery and Preparatory classes! Give your child a strong start in a school where every child gets individual attention.
body: Visit us at 143 Fort Street or call us to book a visit. Ep All Pikin Dem Fo Betteh!

news.title: Our first NPSE candidates
news.imageAlt: A teacher writing on the chalkboard for his class
news.summary: Next academic year, our first group of pupils will sit the National Primary School Examination (NPSE).
body: Our teachers are working hard to prepare them. We are proud of how far we have come!
